experiment: closed-loop HTTP concurrency (one local Uvicorn worker)

parameters.workload: SciFact train-side query texts (no qrels used for scoring)

notes: One local server and one load-generator process on the same computer. Closed-loop fixed-request-count test, not an open-loop target-QPS test. HTTP latency includes client/network/response overhead and queueing; API-reported search time excludes those. Thread concurrency is not GPU-wide batching, multi-GPU training, or production throughput. p99 is especially noisy with small samples. No ranking-quality claims.
